bible.text: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
bible.why: Trust, do good, and you will be provided for.

bible.text: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
bible.why: Delight in the Lord and he will give you the desires of your heart.

bible.text: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
bible.why: Commit your way to the Lord, trust, and he will bring it to pass.

bible.text: He shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
bible.why: He will bring out your righteousness like the light and your cause like the noonday.

bible.text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
bible.why: Stop being angry and let go of wrath; do not fret yourself into doing evil.

bible.text: The meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
bible.why: The meek shall inherit the earth and delight in abundant peace.

bible.text: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
bible.why: The steps of a good person are guided.

bible.text: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
bible.why: Though you fall, you will not be utterly cast down; you are held up.

bible.text: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
bible.why: All my longing and groaning are not hidden from you.

bible.text: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
bible.why: A prayer: do not forsake me, do not be far from me.

bible.text: Now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
bible.why: What do I wait for? My hope is in you.

bible.text: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
bible.why: I waited patiently, and my cry was heard.

bible.text: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
bible.why: Lifted out of the pit and set on solid rock.

bible.text: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
bible.why: Blessed is the one who considers the poor.

bible.text: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
bible.why: Strength is given on the sickbed; care in sickness.

bible.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
bible.why: Why are you downcast, my soul? Hope still.

bible.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
bible.why: Why are you troubled, my soul? Hope in God, for I will yet praise him.

bible.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
bible.why: God is our refuge and strength, a present help in trouble.

bible.text: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea.
bible.why: We will not fear even if the earth itself gives way.

bible.text: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
bible.why: Wash me and cleanse me of my wrongdoing.

bible.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
bible.why: Create in me a clean heart and renew a right spirit.

bible.text: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
bible.why: Restore to me the joy of being saved; uphold me.

bible.text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
bible.why: A broken and contrite heart will not be despised.

bible.text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
bible.why: Cast your burden on the Lord and you will be sustained.

bible.text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
bible.why: When I am afraid, I will trust.

bible.text: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
bible.why: Every tear you shed is seen and kept.

bible.text: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
bible.why: I take refuge under the shadow of your wings until troubles pass.

bible.text: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
bible.why: My soul waits on God; my salvation comes from him.

bible.text: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
bible.why: My soul, wait only on God, for my hope comes from him.

bible.text: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us.
bible.why: Trust at all times; pour out your heart.

bible.text: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
bible.why: A father to the fatherless and defender of widows.

bible.text: Thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.
bible.why: You have been my hope and trust since my youth.

bible.text: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
bible.why: Do not cast me off in old age, when my strength fails.

bible.text: Also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
bible.why: Even when I am old and grey, do not forsake me until I have shown your strength to the next generation.

bible.text: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
bible.why: My body and heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart.

bible.text: Thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
bible.why: You are good and ready to forgive, plentiful in mercy.

bible.text: Thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
bible.why: Full of compassion, gracious, patient, abundant in mercy and truth.

bible.text: Teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
bible.why: Teach us to number our days so we may gain a wise heart.

bible.text: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
bible.why: Satisfy us early with mercy, so we may rejoice all our days.

bible.text: Let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
bible.why: Establish the work of our hands.

bible.text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
bible.why: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High abides in his shadow.

bible.text: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
bible.why: He is my refuge and fortress, in whom I trust.

bible.text: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
bible.why: You are covered and sheltered as under wings.

bible.text: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day.
bible.why: You need not fear terror by night.

bible.text: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High.
bible.why: It is a good thing to give thanks.

bible.text: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
bible.why: When I said my foot was slipping, mercy held me up.

bible.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
bible.why: When my thoughts within me are many, your comforts delight my soul.

bible.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
bible.why: Enter with thanksgiving and be thankful.

bible.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits.
bible.why: Forget not all the good you have received.

bible.text: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
bible.why: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, plentiful in mercy.

bible.text: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
bible.why: He has not dealt with us as our wrongs deserve.

bible.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
bible.why: Our wrongs are removed as far as the east is from the west.

bible.text: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
bible.why: As a father has compassion on his children, so does the Lord.

bible.text: He knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
bible.why: He knows how we are made; he remembers that we are dust.

bible.text: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
bible.why: Give thanks, for he is good and his mercy endures.

bible.text: He satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
bible.why: He satisfies the longing soul and fills the hungry with good.

bible.text: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
bible.why: He makes the storm calm and the waves still.

bible.text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
bible.why: Not afraid of bad news, with a heart steady in trust.

bible.text: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
bible.why: I love the Lord because he heard my voice.

bible.text: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.
bible.why: I called out in distress and was answered and set free.

bible.text: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
bible.why: The Lord is with me; I will not fear what people can do.

bible.text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
bible.why: This is the day; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

bible.text: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
bible.why: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me.

bible.text: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
bible.why: This is my comfort in affliction.

bible.text: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
bible.why: Let your merciful kindness be my comfort.

bible.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
bible.why: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.

bible.text: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
bible.why: Great peace have those who love your law.

bible.text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
bible.why: I lift my eyes to the hills, from where my help comes.

bible.text: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
bible.why: My help comes from the maker of heaven and earth.

bible.text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
bible.why: He will not let your foot slip; he who keeps you does not sleep.

bible.text: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
bible.why: The Lord will keep you from harm and preserve your soul.

bible.text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
bible.why: Your going out and coming in are kept, now and always.

bible.text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
bible.why: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

bible.text: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
bible.why: One who goes out weeping, carrying seed, will return rejoicing with the harvest.

bible.text: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
bible.why: Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders labour in vain.

bible.text: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
bible.why: I wait, and in his word I hope.

bible.text: LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
bible.why: My heart is not proud; I do not occupy myself with things too great for me.

bible.text: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
bible.why: I have calmed and quieted myself like a weaned child.

bible.text: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
bible.why: How good it is for people to live together in unity.

bible.text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
bible.why: Give thanks, for he is good; his mercy endures forever.

bible.text: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
bible.why: When I called, I was answered and given strength in my soul.

bible.text: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
bible.why: What concerns me will be brought to completion.

bible.text: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
bible.why: You have searched me and known me.

bible.text: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
bible.why: You know my path and all my ways.

bible.text: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
bible.why: There is nowhere I could go to be away from your presence.

bible.text: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
bible.why: Even there your hand will lead me and hold me.

bible.text: The darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
bible.why: Darkness is not dark to you; the night shines like the day.

bible.text: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
bible.why: I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

bible.text: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
bible.why: How precious are your thoughts toward me.

bible.text: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
bible.why: Set a guard over my mouth.

bible.text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
bible.why: Let me hear your kindness in the morning and know the way to walk.

bible.text: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
bible.why: Teach me to do your will; lead me into the land of uprightness.

bible.text: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
bible.why: The Lord is gracious and full of compassion, slow to anger.

bible.text: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
bible.why: The Lord is good to all, and his mercy is over all he has made.

bible.text: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
bible.why: He upholds all who fall and lifts up those who are bowed down.

bible.text: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
bible.why: The Lord is near to all who call on him sincerely.

bible.text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
bible.why: He heals the broken-hearted and binds up their wounds.

bible.text: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels.
bible.why: A wise person keeps listening and learning.

bible.text: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
bible.why: If others try to lure you into wrongdoing, do not go along.

bible.text: The LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
bible.why: Wisdom, knowledge and understanding come from God.

bible.text: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart.
bible.why: Never let kindness and truth leave you; write them on your heart.

bible.text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
bible.why: Trust in the LORD with all your heart and do not lean on your own understanding.

bible.text: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
bible.why: Acknowledge him in all your ways and your paths will be directed.

bible.text: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
bible.why: Do not be wise in your own eyes.

bible.text: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
bible.why: Happy is the one who finds wisdom and gains understanding.

bible.text: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
bible.why: Wisdom's ways are pleasant and all her paths are peace.

bible.text: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
bible.why: When you lie down you will not be afraid; your sleep will be sweet.

bible.text: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
bible.why: Do not withhold good when it is in your power to do it.

bible.text: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
bible.why: Do not tell a neighbour to come back tomorrow when you can help today.

bible.text: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
bible.why: Wisdom is the main thing; above all, get understanding.

bible.text: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.
bible.why: Hold on to instruction; do not let it go.

bible.text: The path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
bible.why: The path of the just is like a shining light that grows brighter until the perfect day.

bible.text: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
bible.why: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it come the issues of life.

bible.text: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
bible.why: Let your eyes look straight ahead.

bible.text: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
bible.why: Consider the path of your feet and your ways will be steady.

bible.text: Wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
bible.why: Wisdom is better than rubies.

bible.text: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
bible.why: Teach a wise person and they become wiser still.

bible.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
bible.why: Reverence is the beginning of wisdom.

bible.text: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
bible.why: Whoever walks with integrity walks securely.

bible.text: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
bible.why: Those who accept instruction are on the path of life.

bible.text: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
bible.why: Too many words lead to wrong; the wise hold their tongue.

bible.text: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
bible.why: Dishonest scales are hated; fair dealing is a delight.

bible.text: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
bible.why: Pride brings shame; with the humble is wisdom.

bible.text: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
bible.why: A gossip reveals secrets; a trustworthy person keeps a confidence.

bible.text: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
bible.why: In many advisers there is safety.

bible.text: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
bible.why: The merciful person does good to their own soul.

bible.text: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
bible.why: The generous will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.

bible.text: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
bible.why: Some words pierce like a sword, but the tongue of the wise is health.

bible.text: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
bible.why: Truthful lips endure forever; a lying tongue lasts only a moment.

bible.text: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
bible.why: Those who counsel peace have joy.

bible.text: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
bible.why: Those who deal truthfully are a delight.

bible.text: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
bible.why: Heaviness in the heart weighs a person down, but a good word makes it glad.

bible.text: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
bible.why: Wealth gained by vanity dwindles; what is gathered by labour grows.

bible.text: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
bible.why: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a fulfilled longing is a tree of life.

bible.text: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
bible.why: Happy is the one who is kind to the poor.

bible.text: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
bible.why: All hard work brings profit; mere talk leads to poverty.

bible.text: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
bible.why: Whoever is slow to anger has great understanding.

bible.text: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
bible.why: A sound heart is life to the body; envy rots the bones.

bible.text: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
bible.why: Oppressing the poor insults their Maker; showing mercy to the poor honours him.

bible.text: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
bible.why: A soft answer turns away wrath; harsh words stir up anger.

bible.text: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
bible.why: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life.

bible.text: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
bible.why: Better a little with reverence than great treasure with trouble.

bible.text: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
bible.why: Better a simple meal where there is love than a feast with hatred.

bible.text: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
bible.why: A hot-tempered person stirs up strife; one slow to anger calms it.

bible.text: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
bible.why: Plans fail without counsel; with many advisers they succeed.

bible.text: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
bible.why: A word spoken at the right time is good.

bible.text: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
bible.why: The ear that listens to life-giving correction lives among the wise.

bible.text: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
bible.why: Before honour comes humility.

bible.text: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
bible.why: Commit your work to the Lord and your plans will be established.

bible.text: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
bible.why: Better a little with righteousness than great income gained unjustly.

bible.text: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
bible.why: A person plans their way, but the Lord directs their steps.

bible.text: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
bible.why: How much better to get wisdom than gold.

bible.text: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
bible.why: Pride goes before a fall.

bible.text: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
bible.why: Pleasant words are like honeycomb, sweet to the soul and health to the bones.

bible.text: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
bible.why: Whispering gossip separates close friends.

bible.text: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
bible.why: Better to be slow to anger and master yourself than to conquer a city.

bible.text: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
bible.why: Better a dry crust with quiet than a house full of feasting with strife.

bible.text: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
bible.why: Starting a quarrel is like breaching a dam; stop before it bursts.

bible.text: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
bible.why: A friend loves at all times; a brother is born for hard times.

bible.text: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
bible.why: The knowledgeable use few words; a person of understanding has an excellent spirit.

bible.text: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
bible.why: Answering before listening is folly.

bible.text: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
bible.why: The wise heart seeks knowledge and the wise ear listens for it.

bible.text: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
bible.why: To have friends, be friendly; some friends stay closer than family.

bible.text: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
bible.why: Being kind to the poor is like lending to the Lord.

bible.text: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
bible.why: Many plans are in the heart, but the Lord's purpose stands.

bible.text: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
bible.why: What is desired in a person is kindness.

bible.text: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
bible.why: A just person walks in integrity, and their children are blessed.

bible.text: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the LORD, and he shall save thee.
bible.why: Do not say you will repay evil; wait on the Lord and he will save you.

bible.text: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
bible.why: Doing what is just matters more than ritual offerings.

bible.text: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
bible.why: Careful planning leads to plenty; haste leads to want.

bible.text: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
bible.why: Whoever pursues goodness and kindness finds life and honour.

bible.text: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
bible.why: Guarding your mouth keeps you out of trouble.

bible.text: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
bible.why: A good name is better than great riches.

bible.text: The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker of them all.
bible.why: Rich and poor alike were made by the same Maker.

bible.text: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.
bible.why: Humility brings riches, honour and life.

bible.text: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
bible.why: The generous person who shares food with the poor will be blessed.

bible.text: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
bible.why: A person diligent in their work will stand before kings.

bible.text: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
bible.why: Do not wear yourself out to get rich.

bible.text: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
bible.why: Riches can fly away like an eagle.

bible.text: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long.
bible.why: Do not let your heart envy wrongdoers.

bible.text: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
bible.why: Buy truth and do not sell it; also wisdom and understanding.

bible.text: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
bible.why: Do not linger looking at the wine in the cup.

bible.text: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
bible.why: Do not envy those who do evil or want to be with them.

bible.text: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established.
bible.why: A house is built by wisdom and established by understanding.

bible.text: A just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
bible.why: The just may fall seven times and rise again.

bible.text: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth.
bible.why: Do not gloat when someone who wronged you falls.

bible.text: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
bible.why: A word fitly spoken is like golden apples in silver settings.

bible.text: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
bible.why: A person without self-control is like a city with broken walls.

bible.text: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
bible.why: Without wood a fire goes out; without gossip, quarrels die down.

bible.text: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
bible.why: Do not boast about tomorrow; you do not know what a day may bring.

bible.text: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.
bible.why: Let someone else praise you, not your own mouth.

bible.text: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.
bible.why: A friend's heartfelt counsel is as sweet as perfume.

bible.text: Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother's house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
bible.why: Do not forsake your friend or your father's friend; a neighbour nearby is better than a brother far away.

bible.text: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
bible.why: As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.

bible.text: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
bible.why: A faithful person will be richly blessed; hasty riches are not innocent.

bible.text: A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
bible.why: Pride brings a person low; the humble in spirit gain honour.

bible.text: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me.
bible.why: Keep lies far from me; give me neither poverty nor riches, but the food I need.

bible.text: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
bible.why: Speak up, judge fairly, and defend the poor and needy.

bible.text: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
bible.why: She opens her hand to the poor and reaches out to the needy.

bible.text: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
bible.why: Strength and honour are her clothing; she will rejoice in time to come.

bible.text: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
bible.why: She speaks with wisdom, and kindness is on her tongue.

bible.text: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.
bible.why: There is nothing better than to eat, drink, and find joy in your work.

bible.text: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
bible.why: There is a season for everything.

bible.text: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance.
bible.why: A time to weep and a time to laugh; a time to mourn and a time to dance.

bible.text: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
bible.why: God has made everything beautiful in its time.

bible.text: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.
bible.why: To eat, drink and enjoy the good of your labour is a gift.

bible.text: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.
bible.why: Better one handful with quietness than two handfuls with toil.

bible.text: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
bible.why: Two are better than one.

bible.text: If they fall, the one will lift up his fellow
bible.why: If one falls, the other lifts them up.

bible.text: If one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
bible.why: A cord of three strands is not quickly broken.

bible.text: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.
bible.why: Do not be rash with your mouth; let your words be few.

bible.text: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity.
bible.why: Whoever loves money never has enough.

bible.text: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
bible.why: The sleep of a worker is sweet; worry over wealth keeps the rich awake.

bible.text: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
bible.why: Do not be quick to anger; anger lodges in the foolish heart.

bible.text: Wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.
bible.why: Wisdom protects like money does, and gives life to those who have it.

bible.text: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider
bible.why: In good times be joyful; in hard times reflect.

bible.text: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
bible.why: The race is not to the swift nor the battle to the strong; time and chance happen to all.

bible.text: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
bible.why: Cast your bread on the waters; you will find it after many days.

bible.text: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.
bible.why: Whoever waits for perfect conditions never sows or reaps.

bible.text: In the morning sow thy seed, and in the evening withhold not thine hand: for thou knowest not whether shall prosper, either this or that, or whether they both shall be alike good.
bible.why: Sow your seed morning and evening, since you cannot know which will succeed.

bible.text: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
bible.why: Many waters cannot quench love; it cannot be bought.

bible.text: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
bible.why: Learn to do good, seek justice, relieve the oppressed.

bible.text: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
bible.why: Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be white as snow.

bible.text: He shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
bible.why: Swords will be beaten into ploughshares; nations will no longer learn war.

bible.text: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
bible.why: I will trust and not be afraid.

bible.text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
bible.why: Perfect peace for the mind that trusts.

bible.text: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength.
bible.why: Trust in the Lord forever; he is lasting strength.

bible.text: The work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
bible.why: The fruit of doing right is peace, quietness and assurance.

bible.text: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
bible.why: Strengthen weak hands and steady feeble knees.

bible.text: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
bible.why: The everlasting God does not faint or grow weary.

bible.text: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
bible.why: He gives power to the faint and strength to the weak.

bible.text: They that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
bible.why: Those who wait on the Lord will renew their strength; they will run and not be weary.

bible.text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
bible.why: Do not fear, for I am with you; I will strengthen and help you.

bible.text: I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
bible.why: I hold your right hand and say, do not fear, I will help you.

bible.text: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
bible.why: A bruised reed he will not break.

bible.text: Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
bible.why: Do not fear; I have called you by name; you are mine.

bible.text: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
bible.why: When you pass through waters and fire, I will be with you, and they will not overflow or burn you.

bible.text: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
bible.why: Do not dwell on the past.

bible.text: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
bible.why: I am doing a new thing; a way in the wilderness.

bible.text: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
bible.why: Your wrongs are blotted out and not remembered.

bible.text: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
bible.why: Your wrongs are blotted out like a cloud; return.

bible.text: Even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
bible.why: Even to old age and grey hair I will carry you.

bible.text: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
bible.why: Even if a mother could forget her child, I will not forget you.

bible.text: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
bible.why: I have engraved you on the palms of my hands.

bible.text: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
bible.why: Given a tongue to speak a timely word to the weary.

bible.text: The mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
bible.why: Mountains may depart, but my kindness will not depart from you.

bible.text: All thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
bible.why: Your children will be taught and great will be their peace.

bible.text: My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
bible.why: My thoughts are not your thoughts.

bible.text: As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
bible.why: As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than yours.

bible.text: Thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
bible.why: God dwells with the humble and contrite, to revive their spirit.

bible.text: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
bible.why: Share bread with the hungry, shelter the homeless, clothe the naked.

bible.text: If thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noonday.
bible.why: Give yourself to the hungry, and your light will rise in the darkness.

bible.text: The LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
bible.why: You will be guided and be like a watered garden.

bible.text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound.
bible.why: Sent to bind up the broken-hearted and proclaim liberty to captives.

bible.text: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
bible.why: Beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning.

bible.text: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
bible.why: As a mother comforts her child, so will I comfort you.

bible.text: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
bible.why: Blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord.

bible.text: He shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
bible.why: Like a tree by water that does not fear heat or drought.

bible.text: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
bible.why: Heal me and I shall be healed.

bible.text: I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil
bible.why: The Lord's thoughts toward you are of peace and not of evil.

bible.text: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
bible.why: You will call and pray, and you will be heard.

bible.text: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
bible.why: I have loved you with an everlasting love.

bible.text: I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
bible.why: I refresh the weary soul and replenish every sorrowful soul.

bible.text: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
bible.why: Call, and you will be answered and shown great things.

bible.text: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
bible.why: This I call to mind, and therefore I have hope.

bible.text: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
bible.why: His compassions never fail.

bible.text: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
bible.why: The Lord is my portion, so I will hope in him.

bible.text: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
bible.why: The Lord is good to those who wait for him.

bible.text: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
bible.why: It is good to hope and quietly wait.

bible.text: Let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
bible.why: Let justice roll down like waters.

bible.text: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
bible.why: Do justly, love mercy, and walk humbly.

bible.text: I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
bible.why: I will look to the Lord and wait; my God will hear me.

bible.text: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.
bible.why: When I fall, I shall rise; when I sit in darkness, there is light.

bible.text: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
bible.why: He pardons and delights in mercy.

bible.text: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
bible.why: All our sins cast into the depths of the sea.

bible.text: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
bible.why: The Lord is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble.

bible.text: The vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
bible.why: Though it lingers, wait for it; it will surely come.

bible.text: I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
bible.why: I will rejoice in the Lord and be joyful in the God of my salvation.

bible.text: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places.
bible.why: The Lord is my strength and makes me sure-footed on the heights.

bible.text: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
bible.why: He rejoices over you with joy and singing.

bible.text: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother.
bible.why: Judge truly and show mercy and compassion to one another.

bible.text: Oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.
bible.why: Do not oppress the widow, orphan, stranger or poor.

bible.text: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates.
bible.why: Speak the truth to one another and judge for peace.

bible.text: Have we not all one father? hath not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?
bible.why: Have we not all one Father? Did not one God create us?

bible.text: I am the LORD, I change not
bible.why: I am the Lord; I do not change.

bible.text: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
bible.why: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

bible.text: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
bible.why: Blessed are the meek.

bible.text: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
bible.why: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for what is right; they shall be filled.

bible.text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
bible.why: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall receive mercy.

bible.text: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
bible.why: Blessed are the pure in heart.

bible.text: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
bible.why: Blessed are the peacemakers.

bible.text: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
bible.why: You are the light of the world.

bible.text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
bible.why: Let your light shine through good deeds.

bible.text: When thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth.
bible.why: When you give, do not let your left hand know what your right is doing.

bible.text: Give us this day our daily bread.
bible.why: Give us this day our daily bread.

bible.text: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal.
bible.why: Do not store up treasures on earth where they decay.

bible.text: Where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
bible.why: Where your treasure is, your heart will be also.

bible.text: I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
bible.why: Do not worry about what you will eat or wear; life is more than these.

bible.text: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
bible.why: Look at the birds; they are fed, and you are worth more.

bible.text: Why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin.
bible.why: Consider the lilies; they do not toil or spin.

bible.text: Take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
bible.why: Do not worry, asking what you will eat or wear.

bible.text: Seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
bible.why: Seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.

bible.text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
bible.why: Do not worry about tomorrow; each day has enough trouble of its own.

bible.text: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
bible.why: Judge not, that you be not judged.

bible.text: Why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
bible.why: Why look at the speck in another's eye and miss the beam in your own?

bible.text: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
bible.why: Ask and it will be given; seek and you will find.

bible.text: Every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
bible.why: Everyone who asks receives; whoever seeks finds.

bible.text: All things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
bible.why: Do to others what you would want them to do to you.

bible.text: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
bible.why: Not even a sparrow falls unnoticed.

bible.text: The very hairs of your head are all numbered.
bible.why: Even the hairs of your head are numbered.

bible.text: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
bible.why: Do not fear; you are worth more than many sparrows.

bible.text: My yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
bible.why: My yoke is easy and my burden light.

bible.text: Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
bible.why: Moved with compassion, he healed their sick.

bible.text: With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
bible.why: With God all things are possible.

bible.text: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
bible.why: Love God with all your heart, soul and mind.

bible.text: Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
bible.why: Love your neighbour as yourself.

bible.text: Whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
bible.why: Whoever exalts themselves will be humbled; whoever humbles themselves will be exalted.

bible.text: I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in.
bible.why: I was hungry and you fed me; a stranger and you took me in.

bible.text: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
bible.why: I was sick and you visited me; in prison and you came to me.

bible.text: The King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
bible.why: What you did for the least, you did for me.

bible.text: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
bible.why: Watch and pray; the spirit is willing but the flesh is weak.

bible.text: I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
bible.why: I am with you always.

bible.text: Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
bible.why: Peace, be still; and there was a great calm.

bible.text: Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
bible.why: Come away to a quiet place and rest a while.

bible.text: Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
bible.why: I believe; help my unbelief.

bible.text: The second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
bible.why: Love your neighbour as yourself; no commandment is greater.

bible.text: With God nothing shall be impossible.
bible.why: Nothing is impossible with God.

bible.text: He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
bible.why: Whoever has two coats should share with one who has none.

bible.text: As ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
bible.why: As you would have others do to you, do the same to them.

bible.text: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
bible.why: Be merciful, as your Father is merciful.

bible.text: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
bible.why: Give, and it will be given to you, good measure running over.

bible.text: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
bible.why: Out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.

bible.text: A certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him.
bible.why: A Samaritan traveller saw a wounded stranger and had compassion.

bible.text: Go, and do thou likewise.
bible.why: Go and do the same.

bible.text: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
bible.why: Not one sparrow is forgotten by God.

bible.text: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
bible.why: Do not fear; you are worth more than many sparrows.

bible.text: Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
bible.why: Life does not consist in the abundance of possessions.

bible.text: Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.
bible.why: Do not worry about your life, what you will eat or wear.

bible.text: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
bible.why: Consider the ravens; God feeds them, and you are worth more.

bible.text: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
bible.why: Fear not, little flock.

bible.text: Where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
bible.why: Where your treasure is, your heart will be also.

bible.text: Which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
bible.why: Before building, sit down and count the cost.

bible.text: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
bible.why: There is joy over one who turns back.

bible.text: I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.
bible.why: There is joy among the angels over one who repents.

bible.text: He arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
bible.why: The father saw his son far off, ran to him, and embraced him.

bible.text: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
bible.why: Whoever is faithful in little is faithful in much.

bible.text: Men ought always to pray, and not to faint.
bible.why: Always pray and do not lose heart.

bible.text: The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
bible.why: What is impossible with people is possible with God.

bible.text: The light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
bible.why: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not grasp it.

bible.text: Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
bible.why: Neither do I condemn you; go and sin no more.

bible.text: Ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
bible.why: The truth shall make you free.

bible.text: Jesus wept.
bible.why: Jesus wept.

bible.text: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
bible.why: Love one another as I have loved you.

bible.text: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
bible.why: People will know you by your love for one another.

bible.text: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
bible.why: Let not your heart be troubled.

bible.text: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
bible.why: I will not leave you comfortless.

bible.text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
bible.why: Peace I leave with you; let not your heart be troubled or afraid.

bible.text: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
bible.why: Love one another as I have loved you.

bible.text: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
bible.why: In the world you will have trouble, but take heart.

bible.text: God is no respecter of persons.
bible.why: God shows no partiality between people.

bible.text: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
bible.why: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

bible.text: Hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
bible.why: Hope does not make us ashamed, because God's love is poured into our hearts.

bible.text: If we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
bible.why: If we hope for what we do not see, we wait for it with patience.

bible.text: The Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
bible.why: When we do not know how to pray, the Spirit prays with groanings too deep for words.

bible.text: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
bible.why: If God is for us, who can be against us?

bible.text: Be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
bible.why: Do not be conformed to the world, but be transformed by renewing your mind.

bible.text: I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
bible.why: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought.

bible.text: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
bible.why: Let love be sincere; hold to what is good.

bible.text: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another.
bible.why: Love one another like family, and be quick to honour each other.

bible.text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer.
bible.why: Rejoice in hope, be patient in trouble, keep praying.

bible.text: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
bible.why: Share with those in need; practise hospitality.

bible.text: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
bible.why: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.

bible.text: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
bible.why: Live in harmony; do not be proud; associate with the lowly.

bible.text: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
bible.why: Do not repay evil for evil; do what is honourable.

bible.text: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
bible.why: As far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

bible.text: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
bible.why: Owe nothing to anyone except to love one another.

bible.text: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
bible.why: Love does no harm to a neighbour.

bible.text: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.
bible.why: Stop judging one another.

bible.text: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
bible.why: Pursue what makes for peace and builds each other up.

bible.text: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
bible.why: The strong should bear with the weaknesses of others.

bible.text: Receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
bible.why: Welcome one another.

bible.text: The God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
bible.why: May the God of hope fill you with joy and peace.

bible.text: Who maketh thee to differ from another? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it?
bible.why: What do you have that you did not receive?

bible.text: Whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
bible.why: If one member suffers, all suffer with it.

bible.text: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up.
bible.why: Love suffers long and is kind; love does not envy or boast.

bible.text: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
bible.why: Love never fails.

bible.text: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
bible.why: When I grew up, I put away childish things.

bible.text: Now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
bible.why: Faith, hope and love remain; the greatest is love.

bible.text: My beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
bible.why: Be steadfast; your labour is not in vain.

bible.text: Let all your things be done with charity.
bible.why: Let everything you do be done in love.

bible.text: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort.
bible.why: The Father of mercies and God of all comfort.

bible.text: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
bible.why: We are comforted so we can comfort others in any trouble.

bible.text: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair.
bible.why: Troubled on every side, yet not distressed; perplexed, but not in despair.

bible.text: We walk by faith, not by sight.
bible.why: We walk by faith, not by sight.

bible.text: If any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
bible.why: The old has passed away; all things have become new.

bible.text: This I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
bible.why: Whoever sows generously will reap generously.

bible.text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
bible.why: Give as you decide in your heart, not reluctantly; God loves a cheerful giver.

bible.text: We dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
bible.why: Comparing yourselves with others is not wise.

bible.text: My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
bible.why: Grace is sufficient; strength is made perfect in weakness.

bible.text: Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
bible.why: Be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace.

bible.text: Brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
bible.why: Use your freedom to serve one another in love.

bible.text: All the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
bible.why: The whole law is summed up in loving your neighbour as yourself.

bible.text: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
bible.why: Let us not be conceited, provoking or envying one another.

bible.text: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
bible.why: If someone is caught in a fault, restore them in a spirit of meekness, watching yourself.

bible.text: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
bible.why: Bear one another's burdens.

bible.text: Let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
bible.why: Examine your own work, and take pride in it without comparing to others.

bible.text: Let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
bible.why: Do not grow weary of doing good; in due season we will reap if we do not give up.

bible.text: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
bible.why: As we have opportunity, do good to all.

bible.text: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
bible.why: Keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

bible.text: Putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
bible.why: Put away lying and speak truth with your neighbour.

bible.text: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath.
bible.why: Be angry but do not sin; do not let the sun go down on your anger.

bible.text: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
bible.why: Let no corrupt talk come out of your mouth, but what is good for building others up.

bible.text: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice.
bible.why: Put away bitterness, rage, anger, shouting and slander.

bible.text: Be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
bible.why: Be kind and tender-hearted to one another, forgiving one another.

bible.text: Walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
bible.why: Walk in love.

bible.text: Be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit.
bible.why: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to excess.

bible.text: Ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
bible.why: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but nurture them.

bible.text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ.
bible.why: He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

bible.text: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
bible.why: Do nothing from rivalry or conceit; in humility value others.

bible.text: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
bible.why: Look not only to your own interests but also to the interests of others.

bible.text: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before.
bible.why: Forgetting what is behind and reaching toward what is ahead.

bible.text: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
bible.why: Rejoice always.

bible.text: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
bible.why: Let your moderation be known to everyone; the Lord is at hand.

bible.text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
bible.why: Do not be anxious about anything; bring every need to God with thanksgiving.

bible.text: The peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
bible.why: The peace of God, beyond understanding, will guard your heart and mind.

bible.text: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
bible.why: Think on whatever is true, honest, just, pure, lovely and of good report.

bible.text: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
bible.why: I have learned to be content in whatever state I am.

bible.text: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
bible.why: I know how to live with little and with plenty.

bible.text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
bible.why: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

bible.text: My God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
bible.why: God will supply all your needs.

bible.text: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering.
bible.why: Clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.

bible.text: Above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
bible.why: Above all, put on love, which binds everything together.

bible.text: Let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
bible.why: Let peace rule in your hearts, and be thankful.

bible.text: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
bible.why: Fathers, do not provoke your children, lest they lose heart.

bible.text: Whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men.
bible.why: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart.

bible.text: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
bible.why: Let your speech always be gracious.

bible.text: We were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children.
bible.why: We were gentle, like a nursing mother caring for her children.

bible.text: Ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands.
bible.why: Aim to live quietly, mind your own affairs, and work with your hands.

bible.text: Comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
bible.why: Encourage one another and build each other up.

bible.text: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
bible.why: Do not repay wrong with wrong; always seek what is good for all.

bible.text: Rejoice evermore.
bible.why: Rejoice always.

bible.text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
bible.why: In everything give thanks.

bible.text: Ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
bible.why: Do not grow weary in doing good.

bible.text: The Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
bible.why: May the Lord of peace give you peace always.

bible.text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
bible.why: Do not let anyone look down on you because you are young; be an example.

bible.text: Godliness with contentment is great gain.
bible.why: Godliness with contentment is great gain.

bible.text: Having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
bible.why: Having food and clothing, let us be content.

bible.text: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy.
bible.why: Let the wealthy not be proud or trust uncertain riches.

bible.text: God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
bible.why: God has not given a spirit of fear, but of power, love and a sound mind.

bible.text: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
bible.why: Work so as to need not be ashamed.
