bible.text: We have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
bible.why: We have one who understands our weaknesses.

bible.text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
bible.why: Come boldly to find mercy and help in time of need.

bible.text: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil.
bible.why: Hope is an anchor for the soul, sure and steadfast.

bible.text: I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
bible.why: I will be merciful and remember their sins no more.

bible.text: Let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works.
bible.why: Consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds.

bible.text: Faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
bible.why: Faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

bible.text: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
bible.why: Abraham went out, not knowing where he was going.

bible.text: Lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees.
bible.why: Lift up drooping hands and strengthen weak knees.

bible.text: Let brotherly love continue.
bible.why: Let brotherly love continue.

bible.text: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
bible.why: Do not forget to show hospitality to strangers; some have entertained angels unawares.

bible.text: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
bible.why: Remember those in prison and those suffering as if you were with them.

bible.text: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
bible.why: Be content with what you have; I will never leave you nor forsake you.

bible.text: To do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
bible.why: Do not forget to do good and to share.

bible.text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
bible.why: If you lack wisdom, ask God, who gives generously without reproach.

bible.text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
bible.why: Every good gift comes from above.

bible.text: My beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath.
bible.why: Be quick to listen, slow to speak, slow to anger.

bible.text: The wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
bible.why: Human anger does not produce what is right.

bible.text: Be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
bible.why: Be doers of the word, not hearers only.

bible.text: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
bible.why: Look after orphans and widows in their distress.

bible.text: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well.
bible.why: Love your neighbour as yourself.

bible.text: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
bible.why: Show wisdom by good conduct done with gentleness.

bible.text: The wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
bible.why: Wisdom from above is pure, peaceable, gentle and full of mercy.

bible.text: The fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
bible.why: The fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

bible.text: God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
bible.why: God resists the proud and gives grace to the humble.

bible.text: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
bible.why: Humble yourselves and you will be lifted up.

bible.text: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
bible.why: Is anyone suffering? Pray. Is anyone cheerful? Sing.

bible.text: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
bible.why: Confess to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed.

bible.text: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous.
bible.why: Be like-minded, compassionate, loving, tender-hearted and courteous.

bible.text: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
bible.why: Offer hospitality to one another without grumbling.

bible.text: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
bible.why: Use whatever gift you have received to serve others.

bible.text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time.
bible.why: Humble yourselves, and in due time you will be lifted up.

bible.text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
bible.why: Cast all your cares on him, for he cares for you.

bible.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
bible.why: If we confess our wrongs, he is faithful to forgive and cleanse us.

bible.text: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
bible.why: Let us love not in words only but in deed and truth.

bible.text: If our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
bible.why: Even when our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart.

bible.text: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
bible.why: Let us love one another, for love comes from God.

bible.text: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
bible.why: God is love.

bible.text: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
bible.why: Since we are so loved, we ought to love one another.

bible.text: We have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
bible.why: Whoever lives in love lives in God.

bible.text: Behold, I make all things new.
bible.why: Behold, I make all things new.
